name: Keyblade armory
strategy: Build broad Sword Wielder support, then spend banked Light/Darkness on one exact-base form. Final rewards dual investment; Ultimate supports a wide team; Anti abandons gear/healing for burst.
resources: Gear exposure and multiple printed resource thresholds slow the first transformation; keep a second exact base registered for a Main form.
win_condition: Win by sustained chain pressure and Main defeats, not by transforming alone.
counterplay: Gear removal before entry, burst against wounded bases, forcing guards before a large attack.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Nobody memory network
strategy: Convert defeats, filtering and equipment transfer into resilient attack selection. Xion borrows universal combat tags to use cross-franchise armory.
resources: Loot/filter rather than unlimited draws; no direct franchise-only victory.
win_condition: Trade Party Members for one-life pressure while recovering hand quality.
counterplay: Focus the support body; top-deck control does not replace lost cards.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Persona Users / Wild Cards
strategy: Use Persona Manifestation Ability cards as temporary summoned actions, Wild Card subtype adaptation and narrow card selection. Manifestations are not extra persistent Characters.
resources: Named limits bind the Compendium/recursion loop; two-card ultimate costs matter.
win_condition: Assemble mixed-franchise chains and finish with Myriad Truths or conditional Armageddon.
counterplay: Pressure fragile Support, deny the needed target, answer the Finisher Menu.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Driver and Blade pairs
strategy: Pair a Driver with a Blade, transfer compatible gear, and support them with independent franchise bodies.
resources: Blade Awakening deploys from hand with a discard and temporary Special restriction; the pair must be maintained.
win_condition: Sacred Arrow splits pressure between effect damage and combat; Infinity Blade rewards three franchises.
counterplay: Separate or negate a support body; force guarded combat before resources bank.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Ouroboros pair tactics
strategy: Interlink uses one of the three canonical pairs as an Ability-established Fusion State: one active body receives power, the partner gives up attacking, guarding and Specials.
resources: One card and a two-body commitment; no free heal-to-full, attack reset or Transformation immunity.
win_condition: Use class diversity, a linked active attacker and Origin Blade with two eligible Ouroboros when not linked.
counterplay: Remove a partner before payoff; a linked inactive partner cannot help Origin Blade or guard.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: SOLDIER combat package
strategy: Zack and Sephiroth provide printed SOLDIER compatibility; Cloud uses broad Sword Wielder equipment without falsely claiming canonical SOLDIER membership.
resources: Gear investment and self-risk are shared with crossover sword teams.
win_condition: Omnislash converts two Equipment into one answered burst.
counterplay: Temporarily suppress gear or make the attacking body spend its one attack inefficiently.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Eikon Dominants
strategy: Use Dominant bodies for defensive resource staging; Ifrit trades attack availability for wide separate damage.
resources: Ifrit entry needs banked currencies and another Dominant or attrition threshold.
win_condition: Force Party trades, then use Flames of Rebirth to preserve a Main while setting up future combat.
counterplay: Do not feed effect-damage KOs as if they caused player damage; exploit the lost attack on control turns.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Lord / Emblem bond package
strategy: Multiple Lords use broadly compatible sword gear; Alear becomes the set's single Emblem Character form and shares support across franchises.
resources: This is a Lord/Emblem package, not a claim of several different Emblem Characters in the set.
win_condition: Pair sword leaders with another franchise for Great Aether, or commit an equipped solo attacker to Lodestar Rush.
counterplay: Attack the partner/support structure; answer temporary subtype access before attachment.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Divine Dragons
strategy: Dragon classifications bridge FE identities with broad Mage/Guardian tools; class borrowing permits flexible armory.
resources: Dragonstone asks Dragon AND Guardian-or-Mage; not every Dragon automatically qualifies.
win_condition: Use Torrential Roar to suppress tall weapon stacks during a decisive chain.
counterplay: Remove or negate gear, pressure low-output support before its long game.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: YoRHa machine warfare
strategy: Androids combine effect-damage control, repeated physical gear usage and card recovery; 9S locks a used gear ability through the next turn.
resources: Self-risk/recoil, discard costs and explicit recovery delays prevent a free replacement engine.
win_condition: Create a safe decisive Berserk Mode attack or pair Android and Gunner for Pod pressure.
counterplay: Separate-damage shields, precise equipment removal, forcing A2 to expose low HP.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: B.O.W. attrition
strategy: Large creatures contest Party trades; injury and biological support produce resilient combat targets. G-1 is a standalone mutated identity, not a fictitious transformation chain.
resources: No automatic resurrection loop or direct player burn. Complete Global Saturation requires two gear and another B.O.W., not an unavailable transformed B.O.W.
win_condition: Grind one-life Party defeats and finish after guards are depleted.
counterplay: Gunner anti-creature equipment, Anti-Tank Finale, heal reduction.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Andro-Eidos precision
strategy: Use parry/recovery responses to keep a gear-bearing duelist alive, then enter Tachy Mode with a real two-Equipment requirement.
resources: Bank currencies; the form cannot guard and has delayed recoil.
win_condition: Turn defensive survival into Burst Counteroffensive or a gear-supported Tachy attack.
counterplay: Wide chains avoid solo-parry rewards; answer attachment or force recoil timing.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Crossover Sword Wielders
strategy: Share Buster Sword, Levin Sword and class exchange across series rather than named weapon locks.
resources: Balance paid chain participation against an unused free Party attack.
win_condition: Choose tall duo or wide chain pressure; gear transfer keeps sunk resources relevant.
counterplay: Individual ATK suppression and temporary equipment negation; well-paid Allied Guard.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Gunner alliance
strategy: Gunners spread effect damage, suppress guard plans, then use firearm equipment for Party-focused combat.
resources: Consumable Rocket Launcher and Last Magazine sacrifice investment or hand cards.
win_condition: Take Party life points efficiently; Anti-Tank Finale removes a blocker but separate effect KOs themselves give no life damage.
counterplay: Guardian mitigation, force equipment sacrifice before the real attack, protect wounded bodies.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Berserker injury pressure
strategy: Self-inflicted damage unlocks large ATK at a genuine survivability cost. Laphicet turns one injury event into bounded support recovery.
resources: Named caps and nonlethal-self-damage text prevent intentionally reviving an untransformed Main for a free full heal.
win_condition: Convert a wounded window into one heavy chain; Anti Form or B-Mode offer different terminal states.
counterplay: Prevent a single large burst, deny healing, attack the exposed Party body.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Summoner manifestations
strategy: Summoners bridge Persona actions, protected setup and exact-card recovery. There is no unregistered token or hidden summon deck.
resources: Manifestations are spent Ability cards; recursion uses actual cards and named restrictions.
win_condition: Support a mixed attack team while retaining enough guard-capable bodies.
counterplay: Pressure hand resources; graveyard-to-hand is not unrestricted immediate deployment.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Healer / Guardian sustain
strategy: Coordinate guards and bounded restoration; decide which ally can afford to receive the split.
resources: Every guard costs2 Momentum; multiple healing bodies give up attack output and are vulnerable Party targets.
win_condition: Preserve life while taking efficient Party trades; sustain alone does not win.
counterplay: Guard taxes, anti-heal, tall decisive attacks, gear removal; stall is a release watch item.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Tactician forecast
strategy: Use top-deck/hand information to select targets and prepare narrow responses; no blanket hand destruction.
resources: Filtering is not raw card draw; some searches require a discard.
win_condition: Make the opponent's expensive attack or protection miss its best target, then counterattack.
counterplay: Diverse response names and independent threats reduce prediction value.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Martial Artist duelists
strategy: Use hand-reveal/resource sequencing and solo attacks rather than generic seven-body chains.
resources: Solo Finisher commits one card and4 Momentum; guards can still split the total.
win_condition: Final Heaven concentrates pressure on a chosen battle without automatic victory.
counterplay: Allied Guard, specific prevention, forcing defensive commitments first.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.

name: Therion / Tales injury support
strategy: Turn controlled self-risk into resource-efficient attacks while Laphicet and Healers sustain the Party.
resources: Injury is damage, not free currency; card-name caps persist across zone changes.
win_condition: A wounded Therion threatens Lethal Pain, while Sword/Healer teams use Blazing Pillar.
counterplay: Remove support or deny a high-value wounded target; defense before calculation matters.
status: Designed and qualitatively reviewed; full-effect matchup viability not established.
